rep.name: Branches
rep.challenge: Breather: a branching tree. Every leaf is free; clear the leaves and the branches follow.

rep.name: Safe
rep.challenge: The bomb ring is also the key holder: when it explodes the lock opens. Unlock the cover first, then blow the knot, then free the cover.

rep.name: Mirror bomb
rep.challenge: The bomb rides the right gear, which turns opposite to the gear you drag. Aim it at the closed ring below, not the free ring above.

rep.name: Tower
rep.challenge: A tower of gears and bars. The roof bar holds the key of the base. Climb down: roof, gears, base.

rep.name: Fortress
rep.challenge: Two bomb rings are locked, their keys on the two gate bars. Take each gate down with the gear pair (each gate rests only on its gear), then aim each bomb at its own knot; each has a free decoy on the other side.
probs: K2 (#15) starts inside the gap of R7 (#7), so it is free at once.

rep.name: Snake
rep.challenge: Breather: a long snake of rings. Start at the tail and follow it to the head.

rep.name: Cage
rep.challenge: A big ring cages three small ones. Two hook its inner side and hold it; the third holds a pinned bar. Drop the bar first, then turn the cage past both inner hooks and the hook below.

rep.name: Gear bridge
rep.challenge: Four gears in a row turn as one, each the other way from its neighbour. Bars rest on gears 1 and 4; a bomb rides gear 3. Choose one direction that frees the bars and sends the bomb into the knot below, not the free ring above.

rep.name: Spiral
rep.challenge: Rings wind in a curl, smaller to the end. The inner end is locked and its key is the outer end ring. Unwind it in order.
